title: Stainless Steel Screens
description:
We offer three different sizes of Stainless steel screens. Replacing your old worn out screens can revitalize your vaporizers vapour path.
Please measure your old screen and select the appropriate size.
Included
1 x 10 Pack Of Stainless Steel Screens
